full_judgment:
9. Mr. Ahmed Sobhan, 'the learned Advocate appearing for the defendant No. 1 who is the contesting appellant submits that the lower appellate court based his judgment on mere surmise and conjecture and passed it without considering the patta. Ext. B on the basis of which Bidan Bibi had taken settlement of the dispute property; that the courts below erred in law in holding that Yakub Ali was a tenant in respect of the holding and landlord recognised him as tenant of the disputed property; that the lower appellate court illegally refused.to accept the kabulyat produced at the time of hearing of the appeal, that if Yakub Ali was recognised as tenant by the landlord then how defendant No. 1 possesses the disputed property under defendant No. 7 who purchased it from the heir of Adil Mullah who acquired title to the property of Bidan Bigi after her death; that plaintiff took delivery of possession in the disputed property on 10.6.71 and as such it is void in. view of the provision of P.O. No. 12 of 1972, that the decree obtained by the plaintiff in the Money Suit was fraudulent and collusive, that suit is barred by Article 142 of the Limitation Act, that the suit is bad for defect of parties and in the above circumstances the judgment and decree passed by the Court below are liable to be set aside. 

 11. The lower appellate Court has come to the findings that Alpina died without any heir and as such the question of substitution of her heirs does not arise. The objection is; therefore, not tenable in view of the finding of the lower appellate Court.  Ext. B, the patta is in favour of Bidan Bibi but possession has been recorded in the name of Yakub Ali. The case of the plaintiff is that Yakub Ali cook lease of the disputed property from the landlord. The courts below found that Yakub Ali was a tenant in respect of the holding and his tenancy was recognised by the landlord. The courts below held the document Ext. 8 and 9 support the case of the plaintiff, that ex-landlord Gour Charan Das obtained a decree in Money. Suit No. 60 of 1941 against the Yakub Ali for recovery of arrear of rent. The lower appellate Court further held on the basis of Ext. 16 series that ex-landlord Gour Charan Das and his son Prem Chandra Das and subsequent transferee Golam Akbar recognised him as tenant. The learned Advocate for the appellant submits that Ext. 16 series could be manufactured at any time but there is nothing to support the submission of the learned Advocate; on the other hand the courts below found that the documents were very old and they were kept in ordinary course of business and that they are genuine. When the courts below held that Yakut, Ali had tenancy right in the disputed property failure to accept the kabuliyat alleged to have been executed by Bidan Bibi as additional evidence by the lower appellate Court at the appellate stage does not appear to be illegal. It was further held that by the courts below that the property was correctly recorded in the name of Alpine Bibi and defendant No. 2 in Ext. A(1). It was also held that documents Ext. 1-7 produced by the plaintiff prove that he has acquired title to the property and that the plaintiff took symbolical possession in the disputed property on 10.6.71.
